data_description: The input data is a code generation error that LLMs can produce. Each entry contains information about a programming task with an incorrect implementation and its corresponding correct solution.
use_case: Analyzing code generation errors that LLMs can produce, and categorizing them into syntactic characteristics that help identify the high-level root causes of these code generation errors. Analyzing these syntactic characteristics can help understand the limitations of current LLMs in generating syntactically correct programs.
